instruction:
Structural Frame Retrofit IFC With Revit Quantity Schedule CSV

This task starts from C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init.ifc and uses the local reference image C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\init_sheet.png. In Revit, modify the starting model into a structural frame scheme, export the model as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc, and export a Revit structural count schedule as C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv in the Desktop.

## Pass conditions
1. The output folder contains C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv; C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc is at least 500 bytes and C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is at least 20 bytes.
2. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.ifc uses an IFC4 schema.
3. All IfcRoot GlobalId values are unique.
4. The IFC model contains exactly 1 IfcProject, 1 IfcSite, 1 IfcBuilding, 1 IfcBuildingStorey, 1 IfcSlab, 15 IfcColumn entities, and 22 IfcBeam entities.
5. The IFC model contains 0 IfcSpace, 0 IfcWall, 0 IfcRoof, 0 IfcDoor, 0 IfcWindow, 0 IfcStair, 0 IfcCurtainWall, and 0 IfcBuildingElementProxy entities.
6. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv is a Revit schedule export with exactly the headers category,count in that order and exactly 2 non-empty data rows.
7. C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv contains rows with these exact category and count values: columns=15 and beams=22.
8. The C:\Users\Administrator\Desktop\result.csv counts for columns and beams match the IFC counts of IfcColumn and IfcBeam.

Any item not explicitly required in the pass conditions may vary.
